integrity: Analytic proof with finite reproducibility checks; mathematical validity and literature precedence have no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly dimension three, rank-one positive spike I+theta uu^T, one Lanczos node, independent Rademacher signs, mean of estimator only; not MSE, multi-node, runtime, or an arbitrary-spectrum claim. Two nodes are exact in exact arithmetic for this two-eigenvalue model.
title: Sharp orientation bifurcation for one-node stochastic Lanczos log-determinants
